Class PinTable

java.lang.Object
org.roux.lock.PinTable
public class PinTable extends Object
The PinTable counts how many reads are using each page. A pin is that in-flight count. pin(int) raises the count. unpin(int) lowers the count and drops a zero. waitUnpinned(int, long) waits until the count is zero or the wait times out. A later spill can wait on that count. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#PinTable roux-v1.md

  • Method Details

    • pin

      public void pin(int pageId)
      The method raises the pin count for one page. A missing page starts at zero and then becomes one. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#PinTable roux-v1.md
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the page being read.

    • unpin

      public void unpin(int pageId)
      The method lowers the pin count for one page. A missing page is left unchanged. A count that falls to zero or below is removed.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the page that finished a read.

    • count

      public int count(int pageId)
      The method returns the pin count for one page. A missing page returns 0.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the page to inspect.
      Returns:
      The count is the number of in-flight reads.

    • waitUnpinned

      public boolean waitUnpinned(int pageId, long timeoutMs)
      The method waits until the page has no pins. The wait sleeps for 5 milliseconds between checks. The wait stops when the deadline passes. An interrupt stops the wait and sets the interrupt flag again.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the page to wait for.
      timeoutMs - The timeout is the maximum wait in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when the count reached zero.
